title: Research
intro: Ask a question that takes several searches. Starpi searches your documents and, if you like, the web, checks every sentence and keeps the report on this device. Jobs keep running while you work elsewhere.
question_placeholder: What do you want to find out?
strip_pii: Remove e-mail addresses, phone numbers and similar details from the web search
started: Research started. It keeps running in the background.
start_failed: The research could not be started.
empty: No research yet. Your jobs and their reports appear here.
queued_hint: Waits until fewer than three jobs run.
elsewhere: Runs in another tab of Starpi.
stale_hint: The page was closed or reloaded while this job ran. Retry runs the parts that are missing.
failed_hint: The job failed ({code}). Retry runs the parts that are missing.

via.quote: Quoted from your documents: no model was available

fallback: The model failed ({code}), so the best matching sentences are quoted instead.
gate_counts: {released} {released:sentence|sentences} kept · {withheld} withheld by the sentence check
no_answer: Your documents gave no answer to this question.
web_released: Checked as a whole: every number lies in a passage the search results support.
web_withheld: The web answer is withheld because it did not pass the check as a whole: {reason}. Only the pages it consulted are listed.
web_off: No web search: none of your providers searches the web, and this site offers none.
web_empty: Nothing was left of the question for a web search once personal details were taken out.

web_reason.web_ungrounded: a number lies outside every passage the results support
web_reason.chars: it contains characters that cannot be checked
web_reason.joined: it contains digits that could be misread
web_reason.number_word: a number word has no support
web_reason.spoken_mismatch: reading it aloud would change a number

report.title: Research report
report.quoted: Quoted from the documents without a model
report.no_document_answer: The documents gave no answer to this question.
report.web_sources: Web pages (listed, not verified against the pages)
report.receipt_note: The answer receipt covers the part from the documents; web pages are listed but not verified.

prefilled: The question is in the Research tab. Adjust it and start the research.
